seed_derivation: ChaCha20Rng::from_seed(sha256(seed.to_le_bytes() || 0 || source || 0 || key)); sample order sha256((seed+1).to_le_bytes() || 0 || source || 0 || key)

prose.basis: rajpurkar/squad_v2's registered licence (qd_data.sources); share-alike, carried per row

scrambled.basis: per row: the corpus row's pool_id -> commitpackft pool -> bigcode/commitpackft download (commit, new_file), as the main defect corpus is joined

unseen-language.basis: authored in this repository (crates/qd-mutate/src/noul_rows/templates.rs) and released under its LICENSE, Apache-2.0 -- the workspace licence in Cargo.toml

preregistered.decision: Fable I-2 with the template question decided as option (b): noul at 10% of defect rows (5,004 rows), with prose and scrambled carrying the increase and unseen-language capped at v2's count

defect_class_in_distribution_abstention.kind: F3: Fable's data-design bound and the cost check on I-2, not a gate

form_mix.basis: paragraph and question at their ceiling (3 per title over 335 train titles); template at v2's 834; scrambled the remainder of 5,004, split evenly

preregistered.gates_unchanged: ood_abstain (Wilson lower >= 0.90 OOD, Wilson upper <= 0.05 in-distribution) is read-only (rule 2)
preregistered.next_iteration: option (c), a second versioned template catalogue, is for the data iteration after F's readout; not started

ood_abstain_by_category.bar: >= 30/60 on every seed (0, 1, 2), each of prose, scrambled, unseen-language

preregistered.recorded: 2026-10-01, before defect-noul-v3b was generated and before any v4 (run F) row
preregistered.risk: a noul set designed to span the suite's three forms passes the suite's forms; whether those three categories are the product's OOD definition is a suite question for the human (rule 2)
preregistered.why: J7g (row 1d93b3ee, as relayed by the lead): the masters average of J4's three seeds abstained on 0/180 OOD cases against 46/33/66 per seed. Fable: unseen-language already took at v2's repeat level, and doubling repeats of 35 template shapes buys memorisation -- a narrow, seed-variable feature of the kind that cancelled in the J4 average. Prose (2-9/60) and scrambled (3-8/60) are where the gap is
